now.title: X-Men Origins: Wolverine
now.text: Sabretooth ambushes Logan and Rogue on a snowy road, then fights him again on the Statue of Liberty.
now.on_a_card_about_b: His older half-brother, who fights beside him for a century.
now.on_b_card_about_a: His younger half-brother and comrade in every war.

proposed.text: Victor is Logan's older half-brother, and they fight side by side through a century of wars. Victor's cruelty drives them apart, and Logan hunts him for revenge before they team up against Weapon XI.

changes.evidence: The X-Men Origins: Wolverine stage carries the X-Men (2000) text (snowy road ambush, Statue of Liberty). In Origins, James flees with his elder half-brother Victor, they fight through the Civil War, both World Wars and Vietnam, join Team X, Logan leaves, hunts Victor after Kayla's apparent death, and the two fight Weapon XI together at Three Mile Island.

proposed.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
proposed.text: In the Void, Sabretooth recognizes Logan and challenges him to a fight, and Logan cuts off his head.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: His half-brother, whom Logan beheads in the Void.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The half-brother who beheads Sabretooth in the Void.

changes.evidence: Deadpool & Wolverine: Sabretooth, one of Cassandra Nova's marauders, recognizes Wolverine, dismounts to challenge his half-brother to a duel, and Wolverine decapitates him.

proposed.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
proposed.text: In the Void, John has Toad knock Logan out and brings him to Cassandra. When John later guns her down for Paradox, Logan knocks him out with a punch.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A former student who captures Logan for Cassandra, and whom Logan punches out.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Captured by John in the Void, then knocks him out.

changes.evidence: Deadpool & Wolverine: Pyro, Sabretooth and Toad find Deadpool and Wolverine; after Sabretooth dies, Pyro orders Toad to knock them out and takes them to Cassandra Nova. In the assault on her lair, Pyro shoots Nova and Wolverine punches him unconscious. The only stage (X2, ally) leaves John as a student in Logan's care.

proposed.title: X-Men: Apocalypse
proposed.text: Stryker keeps Logan caged at Alkali Lake as his Weapon X experiment, until Jean frees him and he tears through Stryker's soldiers.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Keeps Logan caged at Alkali Lake as Weapon X.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The caged Weapon X who breaks loose at Alkali Lake.

changes.evidence: X-Men: Apocalypse: Colonel William Stryker's forces take McCoy, Raven, Peter and Moira to his base, where Scott, Jean and Kurt free them using Stryker's experiment Weapon X (Logan), whose memories Jean partly restores.

now.title: Runaways S1–S2
now.text: Alex and Chase are old friends who reunite to uncover PRIDE and run away together. Alex reassures Chase about his troubles with Gert.

proposed.text: Alex and Chase are old friends who reunite to uncover PRIDE.

changes.evidence: The stage sits on Runaways S1–S2 #1 but its text covers running away together (#10) and Alex reassuring Chase about Gert, which happens while they question Topher in S2E5 (#15). In #1 they only reunite at Alex's house and find PRIDE's sacrifice. Card lines 'fellow runaway' also give away #10.

proposed.title: Runaways S1–S2#10
proposed.text: Alex and Chase run away together as the Runaways.

changes.evidence: Companion to the stage 0 fix: in S1E10 Alex steals a Church van, Chase and Molly rescue Karolina, and the group leaves home together.

now.title: Runaways S1–S2#23
now.text: Jonah's family captures Chase, along with Karolina and Janet.

proposed.text: Jonah, wearing Victor's body, overpowers Chase and traps him with Karolina and Janet in his healing algorithm.

changes.evidence: S2E13 (#23): Jonah himself, possessing Victor, brings Karolina to the Stein Mansion, shrugs off Chase's inhibitor pods, blasts Janet, Chase and Karolina and traps them in the Healing Algorithm. Jonah's family (Wife, Daughter) arrive only after.

proposed.title: Runaways S3#4
proposed.text: Chase pins Jonah down to kill him, but Jonah taunts him about watching the light leave his father's eyes, and Chase falters long enough for Jonah to throw him off.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: The alien wearing Victor's body, whom Chase cannot bring himself to kill.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Victor's son, who pins Jonah but cannot strike.

changes.evidence: Runaways S3E2 Jonah (the Magistrate) cuts Chase's oxygen in the algorithm; S3E4 Chase sneaks up on the Magistrate, pins him and tries to stab him, but the Magistrate says he wants Chase to see his father's eyes go dark, and Chase is thrown off before Nico banishes the Magistrates.

proposed.title: Runaways S1–S2#5
proposed.text: Jonah buys Geoffrey's land and takes him on as a partner, and Geoffrey goes on to kill for Jonah in PRIDE's sacrifices.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: The man who makes Geoffrey his partner, and whom PRIDE kills for.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A PRIDE leader who kills for Jonah.

changes.evidence: Runaways S1E5 'Kingdom' flashback: Jonah offers to buy Geoffrey's Compton land, Geoffrey insists on being his business partner, and Jonah later shows the Wilders the basement where PRIDE's sacrifices to restore Jonah are held. In S1E10 Jonah ignores Geoffrey's warning and attacks the kids. The connection does not start with the S2 kidnapping.

proposed.title: Runaways S3#4
proposed.text: When Nico banishes Jonah and his family, Jonah is driven out of Victor's body.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Heals Victor, then wears his body until Nico drives him out.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The PRIDE member whose body Jonah takes, then loses.

changes.evidence: Runaways S3E4: Nico's Staff of One spell makes the Magistrates vanish; the Magistrate is expelled from Victor's body and Victor, in his own body again, ends up in the Dark Dimension, then returns. The last stage leaves Jonah wearing Victor's body.

proposed.title: Runaways S1–S2#7
proposed.text: After learning Victor is dying, Janet ends her affair with Robert to stand by her husband.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Janet's former lover. She ends the affair to stand by Victor.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Robert's former lover, who ends the affair.

changes.evidence: Runaways S1E7 'Refraction': having learned of Victor's brain cancer, Janet tells Robert 'I've been given an extra moment. I'm gonna take it. Goodbye, Robert,' and tells Leslie she will end the relationship. The affair is not resumed in S2 or S3 (Janet stays with Victor, Robert returns to Tina). Kind after the break is a judgment: friend chosen because Robert still offers his life for her in S1E8.

proposed.title: Cloak & Dagger#18
proposed.text: Evita opens the way into the Dark Dimension and marries Baron Samedi to bring Tyrone back, giving up her chance at love. Afterward she keeps her distance from him.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Marries Baron Samedi to bring Tyrone back, then keeps her distance.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The young man Evita gives up love to save.

changes.evidence: Cloak & Dagger S2E8 'Two Player': Evita marries the Loa Baron Samedi in exchange for Tyrone's safe return from the Dark Dimension and keeps her distance from him afterward; Tyrone finds she has lost her right to love. In S2E10 Tandy notes Evita wants nothing to do with him romantically; she helps with the candle and they part in silence. The romance (partner stage) ends.

proposed.title: Cloak & Dagger#18
proposed.text: Tyrone finds Chantelle dead in her shop, killed by Andre.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: The voodoo priestess who guides Tyrone, until Andre kills her.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The young man Chantelle guides, who finds her dead.

changes.evidence: Cloak & Dagger S2E7: Andre Deschaine kills Chantelle in her shop; S2E8: Tyrone and the others go to the Fusilier store and find her killed. Earlier in S2E2 she still guides him (veve, prayer). Her death is not a stage.
